subject: Stress validation calendar orchestration: performance deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Stress validation calendar orchestration: performance deep-dive scheduling

Hi team,

We need to schedule the technical deep-dive for the performance/latency validation that will accompany the customer demo week. Goal is a live readout of our stress validation results, confirm token throughput targets, and lock the runbook for the staged load test.

Two proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jul 22, 10:00–11:30 (preferred)
- Wed Jul 23, 13:00–14:30 (backup)

Attendees: Redwood infra + perf (Rishi, Marissa), Sales engineering (Ben), Acme engineering (Sam + 2).

Key asks before the meeting:
- Confirm which staging cluster variant we run (g5.12x vs g5.8x) and whether Dedicated capacity is pinned.
- Agree on token throughput targets (sustained tokens/sec, burst cap) and p50/p95 latency SLOs.
- Review runbook draft (attached) and ingestion of synthetic test data.

Attachments: stress-runbook-v1.pdf, env-matrix-070125.csv, token-targets-briefing.xlsx

If either slot works for Acme, Sam — please confirm and call out any constraints (data residency, IP allowlists, log access).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stress validation calendar orchestration: performance deep-dive scheduling

On Mon, Jul 14, 2025 at 15:23, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We need to schedule the technical deep-dive for the performance/latency validation that will accompany the customer demo week.

Thanks Lauren — both slots look possible but I have an exec review that runs long on Tue morning (internal conflict). Can we shift the primary to Wed Jul 23, 13:00–14:30 PT and keep Tue as a short catch-up for pre-checks (30m) at 10:00 PT? That gives us time to finalize the runbook and run a quick smoke test before the deep-dive.

Quick notes on runbook:
- Need a step to confirm KV cache warmup period (we should capture a standardized 2-minute warmup for longer-context models).
- Add a pre-test check that validates model variant (quantized vs fp16) and the expected max_sequence_length — this changes token/sec.

I can own runbook updates and the pre-test checklist; aiming to push v1.1 by Tue EOD.

Rishi
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@acme.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 06:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stress validation calendar orchestration: performance deep-dive scheduling

Lauren / Rishi — thanks for the heads-up. Wed Jul 23 13:00 PT works best for our engineering leads. A couple of clarifying items from our side:

- Test data: we prefer synthetic payloads that mimic our 3 most common prompt shapes; Sam attached a quick spec in a follow-up email (we'll also share a zipped sample).
- Logs: can you confirm we will have request-level ingress/egress logs and token-level timing (or at least timestamps per token batch) for the readout? We need those for our internal compliance review.
- Throughput ask: our initial ask is to validate sustained 12k tokens/sec across 8 concurrent connections with p95 < 450ms for 512-token sequences. If you have a recommended target range, share it and we can reconcile.

We'll plan to have two Acme SREs at the deep-dive and one product lead.

Sam Toliver
Senior Eng Manager, Acme Corp
sam.toliver@acme.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@acme.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -0700

Heads-up — I booked Wed Jul 23, 13:00–14:30 PT on everyone's calendars and added a short 10:00–10:30 PT smoke check on Tue Jul 22. Calendar invites sent.

Attendees (confirmed):
- Redwood: Lauren, Rishi, Marissa, Ben (SE)
- Acme: Sam Toliver + 2 SREs, 1 Product Lead

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cStressPlan (runbook + test payload)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stress validation calendar orchestration: performance deep-dive scheduling

Perfect — thanks all for the quick turn. Final confirmation:

Deep-dive: Wed Jul 23, 13:00–14:30 PT (we'll plan 90m for presentation + Q&A).
Pre-check smoke: Tue Jul 22, 10:00–10:30 PT (15m for infra, 15m for customer connectivity).

Action items (owners):
- Rishi: publish runbook v1.1 (include KV warmup step, model variant checklist) — due Tue 18:00 PT.
- Marissa: provision staging cluster and pin dedicated capacity to g5.12x for the stress window; share allowlist/IPs.
- Ben: confirm invite list and share meeting doc with Acme leads.
- Sam/Acme: upload test payloads to Drive and confirm log capture requirements by Tue EOD.

Token targets agreed as a starting point for the validation exercise: sustained 12,000 tokens/sec across the 8 connections Sam mentioned, p95 target < 450ms on 512-token sequences — we'll aim to document how different model variants impact those numbers in the readout.

I'll run the readout agenda: brief goals (10m), infra architecture + runbook (20m), live stress validation (40m), findings + open items (20m).

Attachments: stress-runbook-v1.pdf (v1.1 to be added after Rishi updates).

See you in the smoke check on Tue.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
